resources.string: Diagnostics
Close
Check the saved subscription and selected profile. Checks do not replace your saved access, select another profile, or connect or disconnect VPN.
Server reachability, HTTPS through a proxy and traffic from other apps are different checks. A result is shown as not tested when it cannot be confirmed.
Allow direct checks

Allow DNS and TCP checks on your underlying connection. If the selected profile is not connected, this also permits fetching the subscription directly. These servers can see your source IP. Checks stop if Android reports a VPN whose owner or route cannot be confirmed; no intentional VPN bypass is performed.
HTTPS checks use gstatic.com and cp.cloudflare.com through the selected running proxy. There is no direct retry if the proxy fails.
